🎥Buster Keaton broke his neck filming a stunt in 1924. He didn't find out for 11 years.

The scene: he runs across the top of a moving freight train in Sherlock Jr., then leaps to grab a water tower's release tube on the way down. The plan was a light splash for the gag. https://t.co/YSKuUz7sGw
